content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the NRLM Karnataka Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 24-09-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of NRLM Karnataka to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the NRLM Karnataka recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the NRLM Karnataka recruitment is 24 September 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in this recruitment?
faq.answer: A total of 34 vacancies are available for multiple positions in the National Rural Livelihood Mission Karnataka.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is online. Candidates need to apply through the official website.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for the NRLM Karnataka recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q5. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The job type for these positions is contractual.

faq.question: Q6. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the National Rural Livelihood Mission Karnataka (NRLM Karnataka).

faq.question: Q7. Where can I find the official notification PDF?
faq.answer: The link to the official notification PDF can be found in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q8. What are the important dates for the application process?
faq.answer: The application process starts on 28 August 2026 and ends on 24 September 2026. Special dates are mentioned for Bengaluru applications.

faq.question: Q9. Can candidates from outside Karnataka apply?
faq.answer: The notification specifies recruitment for Karnataka. For specific eligibility regarding domicile, please refer to the official notification PDF.
